caption: You're not lazy, you're decision-fatigued. Every open tab and unsorted task is one more decision your brain has to make before it can focus on anything. Pomobit cuts that down to one: pick a task, start the timer.
Open the app to focus, end up scrolling for 'inspiration' instead. Sound familiar? The tool isn't the problem, the lack of a starting ritual is. Pomobit gives you one: pick, start, focus.

script.text: Log one rep of the habit you're building.

caption: Pomobit in three steps: pick one task, run one focused session, log one rep of the habit you're building. That's the whole app.

script.text: Every session should count for something.

caption: I built Pomobit because timers alone weren't enough for me. I needed every session to count for something, not just count down. So each focused block logs as a rep of the habit I'm actually trying to build.
